gaps.criterion: No local password, session or credential table exists
gaps.gap: NOT DELIVERED, and deliberately not attempted in this task, because doing it here would have broken the running application rather than improved it. Current state, from the grep the acceptance clause asks for: there is NO session table and NO role table, so two thirds of the criterion already hold - but users.password_hash VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL exists (001_auth_projection.sql:13) and is written by AuthService with bcrypt, so local CREDENTIAL storage is real. Removing it is not a delete: users.id is the target of FIVE foreign-key columns across four tables (leads.owner_user_id, routing_rules.assigned_user_id, sla_metrics.responded_by_user_id, sla_alerts.recipient_user_id and acknowledged_by_user_id), and POST /api/auth/register plus POST /api/auth/login are the auth PRODUCER that essentially every api_definition in tests/api_definitions chains from via {{cache:auth.login.response.data.token}}. Dropping the table in this task would have cascaded into the whole test corpus and left the app unable to authenticate anyone, since no ProjexCloud issuer is reachable in this environment (PROJEXCLOUD_IDENTITY_URL is unset, and the gateway is unconfigured). The honest sequencing is: this task ships the verifier, a later task migrates the identity data and retires the local credential path once an issuer actually exists to migrate to. What IS in place makes that migration a switch rather than a rewrite - platformSession is mounted ahead of the routers and goes live the moment PROJEXCLOUD_IDENTITY_URL is set, leaving the local path in use until then.
